messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Reflection:
{
  "reasoning": "The user requested two distinct operations in parallel: a transfer between accounts and an interest calculation. The model only executed the interest calculation and omitted the transfer entirely, resulting in a function count mismatch.",
  "error_identification": "Turn 0 is missing bank_account.transfer and incorrectly called bank_account_calculate_interest instead of the expected bank_account.calculate_interest. Turn 1 shows the calculate_interest call was never made as a separate parallel operation.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model failed to recognize that both operations should execute in parallel. It appears to have either misinterpreted the request scope or lacked proper function routing, selecting only the interest calculation while completely ignoring the transfer requirement.",
  "correct_approach": "Execute both bank_account.transfer (with source/destination accounts and $5000 amount) and bank_account.calculate_interest (with principal, rate, and time parameters) as parallel function calls in a single turn, matching the user's compound request.",
  "key_insight": "Parallel multiple scenarios require the model to identify all distinct operations in a single user request and invoke all corresponding functions simultaneously, not selectively execute a subset."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".

  {"type": "ADD", "section": "<tool_group>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "REMOVE", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>"}
